description: Variation of planning reference PA25/3147 to vary the condition C3 (Materials to match existing) to render the existing brick work.
decision_conditions: The proposed render cladding on the exterior of the dwelling, by virtue of its appearance, would result in an unsympathetic form of development resulting in irreversible damage and visual harm to the character of the Building of Townscape Merit and the wider Conservation Area. The scheme would cause less than substantial harm to the CA15 Kew Gardens Conservation Area of which it forms part, and there are considered to be no public benefits to outweigh this harm. As such, the proposal would be contrary to Section 72 of The Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990, Chapter 20 of the NPPF (2026), the Richmond Local Plan (2025), in particular policies 28, 29, and 30, and the House Extensions and External Alterations SPD, as supported by the CA15 Kew Gardens Conservation Area Statement and CA15 Kew Gardens Conservation Area Study.
